proposal.hypothesis: Split source ranges with rsqrtf and factor-four unrolling produced the best recorded mean (0.00089948 s), while the corresponding factor-eight candidate measured 0.00101347 s. Testing factor-two unrolling holds the split-range and arithmetic choices fixed while probing whether less unrolling reduces code or register overhead without giving up useful loop-control savings. These search measurements do not establish causality or predict this candidate's result.

retained: Replace the conditional all-source loop with ascending ranges [0, i) and (i, n), so the self-interaction is never evaluated.
Use rsqrtf(distSq) and multiply by its cube in each interaction, retaining target-mass multiplication and final per-target-mass division.
Apply #pragma unroll 2 to both split source loops to test a lower unroll factor than the previously measured factor-four and factor-eight variants.
Preserve one target per thread, the existing integration arithmetic, and the launch configuration; add no shared-memory tiling or multi-target coarsening.
